quiz_templates.title: EHR Training
proof_of_work: Completion proof from the vendor EHR training at {EHR_TRAINING_LINK}
3 screenshots from {EHR_NAME}, fake patients only: a patient search, an upcoming appointment, and an uploaded, correctly named document
quiz_templates.notes: Scoring for situational: 2 = right action and right clicks per the doctor's answers, 1 = right action but wrong or missing clicks, 0 = wrong action.

quiz_templates.title: Texting / VOIP
proof_of_work: Completion proof from both platform trainings ({TEXT_TRAINING_LINK}, {VOIP_TRAINING_LINK})

Module 6 10-text set: 10 sample replies to a fake patient (confirm, unavailable slot, office hours, missed callback, X-ray question, urgent symptoms, unknown number, STOP, insurance guarantee or a replacement for cash offices, cancellation). All 10 must be correct.

quiz_templates.title: Scheduling Cadence
proof_of_work: Module 3 10-sample assessment, booked in {EHR_NAME} with fake patients and screenshotted. Pass = 9/10: new patient slot too short; routine follow-up; reschedule without duplicate; late cancellation; urgent request requiring escalation; protected buffer conflict; unapproved double-book; wrong provider; same-day request after cutoff; doctor-approved exception.
quiz_templates.notes: Every situational answer is checked against M3's Verify list: type, length, provider, buffer, double-booking, approval, documentation, escalation. Any one missed on a booking caps that item at 1.

quiz_templates.title: New Patient & Re-exam Checklists
proof_of_work: The 10 fake patients built in {EHR_NAME} and Trello, each run through the office's New Patient Checklist from Day 0 to Day 6 with every step checked and dated. VFDA spot-checks 3 against {Q_AUDIT_STEPS}.
quiz_templates.notes: Order matters: a step done out of order, or not dated, caps that item at 1 point. Offices without a re-exam card get Part B-alt instead of Part B.

quiz_templates.title: Basic Phone Handling
cards: How To: Open Office with ConnectWise
proof_of_work: Module 4's three required roleplays on the voice call simulator with the office's script loaded: new patient first appointment; existing patient routine scheduling or account question; appointment confirmation. All three must pass.
quiz_templates.notes: Say part graded on M4 checklist: greeting, identity, required questions, approved language, documentation, closing, escalation. Situational: 2 = Say, Do and Book all right; 1 = one part wrong or missing; 0 = two or more wrong. Offices without remote access skip B3 and get a second Email item.

quiz_templates.title: Challenging Phone Handling
proof_of_work: Module 5's three capstone roleplays on the voice simulator: financial objection; upset scheduling patient; safety/privacy/escalation. All three must pass with no unresolved critical error.
VA-written Challenging Call Script & Escalation Checklist, submitted in Slack and approved by the doctor.
quiz_templates.notes: Say part graded on M5 checklist: calm tone, listening/empathy, clarifying questions, approved language, boundaries, escalation, objective notes, closing.

quiz_templates.title: Insurance
proof_of_work: Module 7's three mock verifications (A active, B inactive/terminated/not yet effective, C conflicting or authorization uncertainty), each with every field in {VERIFICATION_FIELDS} recorded or marked N/A with reason, correct escalation, no guarantee of payment.
VA-written Insurance Verification Checklist, approved by the doctor.
quiz_templates.notes: Graded on M7 checklist: accuracy, source, documentation, limits of authority, uncertainty, escalation. Never fabricate unavailable data. Cash-only offices get 20 extra phone drills instead.

quiz_templates.title: Billing
proof_of_work: Insurance track: Module 8's six mock EOB cases on its Mock Case Record, 6/6 with 100% matching and math.
Cash track: six mock cash cases (paid visit reconciled; recurring plan set up; declined card; end-of-day mismatch; duplicate or wrong-patient charge; refund request escalated), 6/6.
VA-written Basic Billing Checklist, approved by the doctor.
quiz_templates.notes: Tracks: billing_type insurance -> Parts A+B; cash -> Parts C+D; both -> Parts A+C. Any math error on a reconciliation item scores 0. Mark missing EOB fields 'not shown'.

quiz_templates.title: Combined Gray Cards
proof_of_work: For each gray card: one demonstration on fake data (screenshots or Loom) start to finish, plus the record from {CARD_DONE}. VFDA checks high-risk cards first.
quiz_templates.notes: Built per office from gray cards using GRAY_FORMULAS and GRAY_SPLIT. Pass = 80% of total points with zero critical errors; review 65-79%; below 65% retake.
